headline: Recommended a contract of up to $140,150.52 with Pare Corporation for engineering evaluations of three water supply dams.
summary: The work is required under Rhode Island dam safety rules, which call for routine inspections of high and significant hazard dams. The combined proposal covers Diamond Hill Reservoir Dam, Arnold Mills Reservoir Dam, and Happy Hollow Pond Dam, with a cost savings of approximately $29,457 compared to separate studies. The FY’25 financial audit was also approved, though the long delay in receiving the final audit was noted.

decision_titles: Dam engineering evaluations by Pare Corporation, up to $140,150.52
plain_text:
PAWTUCKET WATER SUPPLY BOARD 
 
The 448th meeting of the Pawtucket Water Supply Board met on November 10th, 2026 at 5:00 PM  
William Masuck called the meeting to order at 5:00 PM. 
 
PWSB Members Present 
William Masuck, Chairperson – present   
James Bradford, Vice Chairperson – present 
Robert Benson – present 
Roberto Moreno – not present  
Mark Theroux – present 
Jeannine Bourski – not present 
 
PWSB Staff Present 
James DeCelles - Chief Engineer 
Russell Houde – Assistant Chief Engineer 
Katie Peters – Executive Project Manager 
Christopher Collins – Source Water Manager  
Mike Lecours – Chief Financial Officer 
Joe Keough – Attorney – not present 
 
 
Public Attendees 
None 
 
4.  Consent Agenda 
 
A motion to approve the Consent Agenda was made by James Bradford and seconded by Mark 
Theroux. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
James Bradford – Yes
Mark Theroux – Yes  
APPROVED 
 
5A. 2026 Dam Inspections 
 
The Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management (RIDEM) Dam Safety 
Regulations require routine inspection and evaluation of dams classified as High or Significant 
Hazard to assess their condition, identify deficiencies, and maintain compliance with applicable 
dam safety requirements. 
The PWSB has solicited a proposal from Pare Corporation (Pare) of Lincoln, Rhode Island, to 
perform engineering evaluations of three PWSB-owned dams: Diamond Hill Reservoir Dam 
(RI077), Arnold Mills Reservoir Dam (RI078), and Happy Hollow Pond Dam (RI082). 
The combined proposal provides a coordinated assessment of the facilities, including the 
hydraulically interconnected Diamond Hill and_Arnold Mills Reservoir Dams, while providing a 
cost savings of approximately $29,457 compared to separate studies. 
Upon Board approval, it is further recommended that the proposal be forwarded to the City of 
Pawtucket Purchasing Board for review and authorization of a contract with Pare Corporation 
under State MPA No. 584B, in an amount not to exceed $140,150.52. 
A motion to recommend that the Purchasing Board review and authorize the proposal was made 
by Robert Benson and seconded by Mark Theroux. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
James Bradford – Yes 
Mark Theroux – Yes  
APPROVED 
 
5B. FY’25 Financial Audit 
 
The board was asked to approve the FY’25 financial audit. The long delay in receiving the final 
audit was noted.
A motion to approve the FY’25 financial audit was made by Robert Benson and seconded by James 
Bradford. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
James Bradford – Yes 
Mark Theroux – Yes  
APPROVED 
 
 
Next scheduled meeting is December 8th, 2026. 
A motion to adjourn was made by Mark Theroux and seconded by James Bradford. 
Meeting adjourned at 5:09 pm. 
Certified by PAWTUCKET WATER SUPPLY BOARD, recorded by kp 
 
 
 
 
 
William Masuck, Chairperson
